title: Mileage and driving range mentions
summary: This topic is mostly made up of factual mentions of current odometer readings or stated range figures, with only a few clear opinions about desired range, tire-rotation practicality, or early-ownership issues.

positive.summary: Positive reviews mention satisfaction with the vehicle overall or a wish for longer range framed within otherwise favorable feedback.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe early problems by mileage and criticize the staggered wheel setup for making tire rotation inconvenient.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined reviews mostly state mileage or range figures without enough context to classify them as praise or complaints, and some examples mix simple odometer updates with ambiguous range comparisons.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined factual statements about miles or range, which limits sentiment interpretation.
The topic mixes at least two related but distinct subjects: odometer mileage updates and battery or driving range statements.
Some negative examples reference problems beginning at a certain mileage without enough detail to identify the underlying issue.
